title: Solo closes on 30 November. The page does not move itself.
friendlyTitle: Solo closes on 30 November. The website does not move itself.
summary: Mozilla is shutting Solo, the builder that used a language model to make a page and then hosted it. The Register reports that about 54,000 people used it. The Soloist.ai homepage says operations stop on 30 November 2026. Mozilla told The Register it first wrote to customers on 1 October. A ZIP export includes the HTML, form and newsletter submissions, and a spreadsheet of image links. The images are a separate download. Domains bought through Solo have to move to Name.com.
friendlySummary: Mozilla is closing Solo, a tool that used AI to build a simple website and then hosted it. The Register says about 54,000 people used it. The Solo site says it stops on 30 November 2026. Mozilla says it emailed customers on 1 October. You can download a ZIP of the page and the form replies. Photos are a separate download. A domain bought through Solo has to be moved to Name.com.
whyItMatters: An easy builder is not a backup. If the page is the shop, the booking form, or the only copy of the photos, download it before the 30th. Mozilla is not handing the sites to another host. The export is a start, not a finished move.
